question: In which year was the National Tansen Samman instituted?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1980**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Tansen Award was founded in 1980.
 
• Tansen award conferred to the exponents of Hindustani music.
 
• The award is organized every year by the Madhya Pradesh culture department in memory of Tansen.
 
• The award is presented during the Tansen Samaroh at Gwalior.
 
• Indian Hindustani vocalist Vidyadhar Vyas was honored with the Tansen Samman in 2019.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Tansen was an Indian musician and poet.

 
 
• The famous singer Tansen was from Gwalior.
 
• He was an important figure in the North Indian tradition of Hindustani classical music.
 
• He was a court musician during the reign of the Mughal emperor Akbar.
 
• He is considered one of the Navaratnas (nine jewels) of Akbar's court.
